purpose: Turn launch gate states into the first production backend contract without adding UI weight.
rule: One visible business action maps to one production record.
phase: Active prototype moving toward production SaaS
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, or booking commission handling in phase one. Buyer pays supplier directly; Heavyster earns paid listing SaaS.

records.name: SupplierAccount
records.purpose: Company profile, regions, contact desk, team users, approval status, and listing plan.

records.name: EquipmentListing
records.purpose: Category, make, model, location, availability, rate notes, proof links, visibility, and listing status.

records.name: ProofDocument
records.purpose: Photos, license, insurance, inspection, operator certificates, expiry dates, and review notes.

records.name: DirectEnquiry
records.purpose: Buyer note, selected listing, supplier route, proof snapshot, status, and response log.

records.name: ListingSubscription
records.purpose: USD 9 monthly or USD 99 yearly active listing state, renewal date, and billing status.

records.name: AdminReview
records.purpose: Supplier approval, proof gaps, suspicious listing checks, support notes, and visibility decisions.

records.name: MarketSignal
records.purpose: Region-category demand, supply gap, verified listing count, ARR signal, and next wedge decision.
